outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Skamania County precinct results, November 5, 2024 general (23 precincts). 'Skamania Commissioner No. 1' (Brian Nichols 4,603, Mary Ellen Grode 2,165), 'Skamania Commissioner #2' (Rob Farris 4,331, Mary Repar 2,583) and 'PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT Commissioner #1' (Dan Boyes 3,533, Mel Steele 2,544) appear in all 23 precincts; 'Skamania Sales and Use Tax For Funding Sheriff's Office Personnel' was rejected 3,750 to 3,297.
